Messages.Author: technobabble66
Messages.Body:
If i hv a minion who uses spirit marionette to "borrow" another meth's
minion, then use heidelberg to drain them completely so they're forced
to hunt, at what point does The Ankou use his ability? Is it while the
stolen minion is still under my control, or does the minion return to
the actual owner of the minion, then The Ankou may attempt to burn it?
I assume the minion returns first.
I'm particularly concerned abt effects such as Tension in the Ranks...

Spirit Marionette
Action
Dominate
(D) Bleed at +1 bleed.
Obeah
(D) Bleed at +1 bleed and tap a ready minion controlled by your prey
(even if the target of the bleed is changed).
+1 stealth action. (D) Take control of a ready untapped minion until
the end of the next action. That minion must bleed your prey unless he
or she must hunt.

Ankou, The
Malkavian
Capacity: 10
Group: 5
Camarilla: When any vampire successfully hunts while the Ankou is
ready and untapped, the Ankou may burn that vampire as a (D) action
that turn (even on another Methuselah's turn).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jun 5, 7:29 am, technobabble66 <stujaq...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> If i hv a minion who uses spirit marionette to "borrow" another meth's
> minion, then use heidelberg to drain them completely so they're forced
> to hunt, at what point does The Ankou use his ability?

In the normal sequence.

> Is it while the
> stolen minion is still under my control, or does the minion return to
> the actual owner of the minion, then The Ankou may attempt to burn it?
> I assume the minion returns first.

Correct.

And then you get to take any other actions you wish.
Then your prey. (back to you if the prey takes ay action).
Then your grand-prey. (back to you if ...)
And so on around the table until you get to Ankou's controller.


